info.name: ShipInsure Covered Orders (local)
info.description:
Webhook requests for the local Chalice server (`chalice local --stage local --port 8000`).

Send '1. Happy path' in order, or in any order: the final ledger is the same. Resending a request is treated as a duplicate delivery. Delete shipinsure.db in the repo folder and restart the server to start over.

item.name: 1. Happy path (original order -> subscription -> renewal)
item.description: Send in order, or in any order: the final ledger is the same. Expect two 2.50 USD charges, on O (covered_direct) and R (covered_inherited).
